about: Where PlayTrickster differs from the wiki's skill pages (data/builds.json). Each entry replaces those fields of the skill in every job that has it. Fields: items [{ name, qty }], tm, master, learn, needs [{ name, lv }], how { kind, text }. 'src': 'client' = taken from the PlayTrickster client tables and not yet seen in game (Fatal Wound showed the client is right where the wiki differs). 'checked' says who checked what, and when.

formulas.about: How the Planner works out a skill whose wiki formula it can't read as written. calc = the same formula in words it knows (stats, level table columns, Gun AP / Throw AP / Current WT / Light skills typed in on the Planner); calc false = no number (why says what it is instead). why is shown under the skill. The wiki formula is still what the page shows.

Inferno Blade.why: The wiki's "Attack" is read as AP (like Flaming Fist). Not checked in game.

Tempest Strike.calc: Least: AP × Magnification Most: AP × (Magnification + Wind Attr × 5)
Tempest Strike.why: The Wind part is random, 0 to 5 times your Wind %.

Gale Strike.calc: Least: AP × Magnification Most: AP × (Magnification + Wind Attr × 7)
Gale Strike.why: The Wind part is random, 0 to 7 times your Wind %.

Wind Blade.why: Each shock; the level table gives how many.

Heart's Grace.why: Heals, not an attack: (max HP ÷ 200 + MA × 0.2) × Multiplier.

Celestial Strike.why: Light skills = how many light attack skills you have: type it in above.

Chain of Knives.calc: Without Precise Pitch: (DA × 16 + Throw AP) × m With Precise Pitch: (DA × 16 + Throw AP × 2.4) × m
Chain of Knives.why: Precise Pitch's multiplier is taken as 2.4 (its Master, as in Fan of Knives' formula).

Pouch of Pain.why: WT is your max weight; type the weight you carry (shown in shops) above.

Shooting Spree.why: Each hit; type your gun's AP above.

Berserk.why: Each hit; type your gun's AP above.

Double Shot.why: Each of the two shots; type your gun's AP above.

Impelling Rage.why: The wiki's "Modifier Pattern" is read as the Attack % column. Not checked in game.

Power Charging.why: The wiki's "Modifier Pattern" is read as the Attack % column. Not checked in game.

Flux Capacitor.why: Not an attack: it turns HP (max HP × r) into MP (× c).

Lucky Fist.why: Needs the monster's max HP: (monster's max HP ÷ 10 + LK × 8) × Power.

Poison Pouch.why: A share of Pouch of Pain's damage (AP Weight of the Pouch).

Galder Thrower.why: Fixed damage: the Damage column of the level table.

Galder Barrage.why: Fixed damage: the Damage column of the level table.

Fist Full of Galders.why: Fixed damage: the Damage column of the level table.

Furious Galder Throw.why: Fixed damage: the Max Damage column of the level table.

Light Shield.why: A buff (Light resistance, DP and MD), not an attack.

Oath of Light.why: A buff (max HP), not an attack.

Icey Shackles.why: The wiki has no formula for it yet.

Thunderbolt.why: The wiki has no formula for it yet.

Botulism Cloud.why: The wiki has no formula for it yet.

hybrids.about: Made by scripts/client/build-hybrids.js from the client's Item_SkillCardParam (Job column). Per hybrid job: add = skills of the other line it can learn that the wiki's job page leaves out (copied from that line, with this TM); tm = the TM the client asks of it. Not yet seen in game.
